│ and ds:\n    import math\n    # try find sequences of numbers\n    nums =    │

│ pts = list(zip(nums[0::2], nums[1::2]))\n    for a,b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):\n │
│ segments.append((a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1]))\n\n# compute bounds\nxs = [x for   │
│ seg in segments for x in (seg[0],seg[2])] if segments else [vb_x,            │
│ vb_x+vb_w]\nys = [y for seg in segments for y in (seg[1],seg[3])] if         │
│ segments else [vb_y, vb_y+vb_h]\nminx, maxx = min(xs), max(xs)\nminy, maxy = │
│ min(ys), max(ys)\n\n# choose target width\ntarget_w = 4000\nscale = target_w │
│ / vb_w\nW = int(math.ceil(vb_w * scale))\nH = int(math.ceil(vb_h *           │
│ scale))\n\n# create image buffer grayscale 0..255\nbuf = bytearray([255]) *  │
│ (W * H)\n\n# helper functions\ndef put_pixel(x,y,val):\n    if 0 <= x < W    │
│ and 0 <= y < H:\n        buf[yW + x] = val\n\n# draw thick line using        │
│ Bresenham and draw circle around points for thickness\n\ndef                 │
│ draw_line(x0,y0,x1,y1,thickness=2):\n    x0 = int(round(x0)); y0 =           │
│ int(round(y0)); x1 = int(round(x1)); y1 = int(round(y1))\n    dx = abs(x1 -  │
│ x0); dy = abs(y1 - y0)\n    x, y = x0, y0\n    sx = 1 if x0 < x1 else -1\n   │
│ sy = 1 if y0 < y1 else -1\n    if dx > dy:\n        err = dx // 2\n          │
│ while x != x1:\n            # draw circle\n                                  │
│ draw_disk(x,y,thickness)\n            err -= dy\n            if err < 0:\n   │
│ y += sy\n                err += dx\n            x += sx\n                    │
│ draw_disk(x1,y1,thickness)\n    else:\n        err = dy // 2\n        while  │
│ y != y1:\n            draw_disk(x,y,thickness)\n            err -= dx\n      │
│ if err < 0:\n                x += sx\n                err += dy\n            │
│ y += sy\n        draw_disk(x1,y1,thickness)\n\ndef draw_disk(cx,cy,r):\n     │
│ r = int(r)\n    rr = rr\n    x0 = max(0, cx-r); x1 = min(W-1, cx+r)\n    y0  │
│ = max(0, cy-r); y1 = min(H-1, cy+r)\n    for yy in range(y0, y1+1):\n        │
│ dy = yy - cy\n        dy2 = dydy\n        # compute x range\n        # x     │

│ for xx in range(xa, xb+1):\n            buf[off + xx] = 0\n\n# draw all      │

│ ex = (x1 - vb_x) * scale\n    ey = (y1 - vb_y) * scale\n    # SVG y-axis     │
│ downwards matches image coordinate\n    # thickness in pixels\n              │
│ draw_line(sx, sy, ex, ey, thickness=2)\n\n# write PNG grayscale\n\ndef       │
│ write_png(filename, width, height, buf):\n    # buf is bytes length          │

│ range(height):\n        start = ywidth\n        raw += b&#x27;\x00&#x27; +   │
│ bytes(buf[start:start+width])\n    comp = zlib.compress(raw, level=9)\n      │
│ def chunk(cname, data):\n        return struct.pack(&#x27;>I&#x27;,          │
│ len(data)) + cname + data + struct.pack(&#x27;>I&#x27;, zlib.crc32(cname +   │

│ comp)\n    png += chunk(b&#x27;IEND&#x27;, b&#x27;&#x27;)\n    with          │

│ version: increase thickness and scale\nscale2 = 2.0\nW2 = int(Wscale2); H2 = │

│ scale2))\n    ex = int(round((x1 - vb_x) * scale * scale2))\n    ey =        │
│ int(round((y1 - vb_y) * scale * scale2))\n    # reuse buffer but need        │

│ rr = rr\n        x0_ = max(0, cx-r); x1_ = min(W2-1, cx+r)\n        y0_ =    │
│ max(0, cy-r); y1_ = min(H2-1, cy+r)\n        for yy in range(y0_, y1_+1):\n  │
│ dy = yy - cy\n            dy2 = dydy\n            dxmax =                    │
│ int(math.sqrt(max(0, rr - dy2)))\n            xa = max(0, cx - dxmax)\n      │
│ xb = min(W2-1, cx + dxmax)\n            off = yyW2\n            for xx in    │
│ range(xa, xb+1):\n                buf2[off + xx] = 0\n    def                │
│ draw_line2(x0_,y0_,x1_,y1_,thickness=3):\n        x0_ = int(round(x0_)); y0_ │
│ = int(round(y0_)); x1_ = int(round(x1_)); y1_ = int(round(y1_))\n        dx  │
│ = abs(x1_ - x0_); dy = abs(y1_ - y0_)\n        x, y = x0_, y0_\n        sx = │
│ 1 if x0_ < x1_ else -1\n        sy = 1 if y0_ < y1_ else -1\n        if dx > │

│ < 0:\n                    y += sy\n                    err += dx\n           │
│ x += sx\n            draw_disk2(x1_,y1_,thickness)\n        else:\n          │

│ draw_disk2(x,y,thickness)\n                err -= dx\n                if err │
│ < 0:\n                    x += sx\n                    err += dy\n           │
│ y += sy\n            draw_disk2(x1_,y1_,thickness)\n    draw_line2(sx, sy,   │
│ ex, ey, thickness=3)\n\nwrite_png(png_ocr, W2, H2, buf2)\n\n# write summary  │
